subject: Biggoron's Eyedrops
text: Delivering Biggoron's Eyedrops to Biggoron on Death Mountain has a four minute time limit.

evidence.quote:
Time Limit: 4:00

You've now got to run clear across Hyrule and climb Death Mountain in less then
four minutes.

subject: Biggoron
text: Ride Epona to Kakariko Village and travel up Death Mountain Trail to deliver the Eyedrops to Biggoron.

evidence.quote:
Step outside the Observatory and get back on Epona.  Ride her back to Hyrule
Field, and jump back over the fences.  Go to Kakariko Village in the northeast
corner of the zone.  Get off Epona and enter the Village, then go to Death
Mountain Trail in the north of the Village...Give Biggoron the Eyedrops.

subject: Sun's Song
text: Playing the Sun's Song six times forces three days to pass while waiting for Biggoron to repair the sword.

evidence.quote:
Play the Sun's Song six times to force three days to pass, then
show Biggoron your Claim Check.

subject: Biggoron
text: Showing the Claim Check to Biggoron rewards Link with the Biggoron Sword.

evidence.quote:
show Biggoron your Claim Check.  He'll give you the Biggoron Sword for all your
trouble.

subject: Biggoron Sword
text: The Biggoron Sword deals twice the damage of the Master Sword, but prevents Link from using a shield while wielding it.

evidence.quote:
The Biggoron Sword deals twice the damage that the Master Sword does,
but is so large that you can't handle a Shield while using it.

subject: Treasure Room
text: The central Treasure Room of the Gerudo Training Ground contains the Ice Arrows.

evidence.quote:
The Gerudo Training Ground is a series of obstacle courses and timed
challenges, built in a rough square around a central "Treasure Room."  This
Treasure Room contains, among other useless trinkets, the Ice Arrows.

subject: Ice Arrows
text: Reaching the Ice Arrows requires a minimum of seven Small Keys.

evidence.quote:
You need a minimum of seven keys to reach the Ice Arrows, and once you have acquired this number of keys the
dungeon is essentially "finished" and you can go about your business elsewhere.

subject: Gerudo Training Ground
text: The Gerudo Training Ground cannot be fully completed without the Silver Gauntlets from the Spirit Temple.

evidence.quote:
The dungeon cannot be completed "fully" without the Silver Gauntlets from the
Young Link portion of the Spirit Temple.

subject: Gerudo Training Ground Entrance
text: The entrance to the Gerudo Training Ground is situated on the southeastern edge of Gerudo Fortress after Link rescues the Carpenters.

evidence.quote:
The Gerudo Training Ground is only available after Adult Link rescues the
captured Carpenters in Gerudo Fortress and becomes an honorary Gerudo Thief...The entrance to the Training Ground is on the
southeastern edge of the Gerudo Fortress.  Speak with the Gerudo Lieutenant
standing near the steel grating, pay the entrance fee, and she will let you in.

subject: Entrance Room
text: Shooting the golden eye switch above the entrance door spawns a chest containing arrows.

evidence.quote:
At the top of the
stairs, turn around and look up above the door frame to see a golden eye
switch.  Shoot the eye switch with an arrow, and a chest will appear in between
two of the pillars in the room.  Open it to get a bundle of arrows.

subject: Entrance Room
text: A chest between the opposite pillars in the entrance room contains a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Another
chest in between the pillars opposite contains a Blue Rupee.

subject: Entrance Room
text: The door directly opposite the entrance leads to the Treasure Chamber, while doors to the left and right lead into the Training Ground.

evidence.quote:
There are three doors in this room.  The one directly opposite the entrance
leads to the Treasure Chamber, which should be your last destination.  The
doors to the left and right of the Treasure Chamber go to the Gerudo Training
Ground.

subject: Sand Stalfos Room
text: Defeating the two Stalfos in the Sand Stalfos Room within one minute makes a chest containing a Small Key appear.

evidence.quote:
Run past the Blade Trap and
into the room, and a pair of Stalfos will appear.  Defeat them in the usual
fashion, and in under 1:00, and a chest containing this room's Small Key will
appear.

subject: Silver Rupee/Rolling Boulder Room
text: Collecting all the Silver Rupees in the Rolling Boulder Room within the 1:30 time limit unseals the exit door.

evidence.quote:
Time Limit: 1:30...This Silver Rupee will unseal the door at
the back of the room.

subject: Large Block Room
text: Defeating all four Wolfos in the Large Block Room spawns a chest containing arrows.

evidence.quote:
Once
all four Wolfos are dead, a chest will appear which contains a bundle of
arrows.

subject: Like-Like Room
text: Defeating the three Like-Likes behind the blue block reveals an invisible chest in a small pit containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Enter this door to find a small room
which houses three Like-Likes.  Kill them all, and two chests will appear.  Use
the Lens of Truth and look in one of the small pits in the room to find an
invisible chest, which contains a Small Key.

subject: Large Block Room
text: Destroying the false door and looking above it with the Lens of Truth reveals an invisible passage with a target.

evidence.quote:
Destroy the False Door against the wall using Bombs or the Megaton Hammer, then
look on the wall above it with the Lens of Truth to see an invisible passage.  Pull yourself up to the Longshot Target with the Hookshot/Longshot.

subject: Totem Room
text: Entering the door on the high right ledge of the Totem Room leads to a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
When you enter the room, you will be on a high ledge.  Run along the ledge to
the right, where there is a door.  Go through it and open the chest inside to
get a Small Key, then return to the Totem Room.

subject: Totem Room
text: Shooting all the statue's eyes with arrows in one pass from the rotating platform drops a chest with a Small Key and unlocks the lower door.

evidence.quote:
After all of the eyes are pierced with arrows, then a chest will fall down in
front of the statue, and the door on the lower level will unlock.  Pull
yourself over to the chest with the Longshot (just jump if you don't have the
Longshot), and then open the chest to get a Small Key.

subject: Flaming Enemy Room
text: Defeating all the Fire Slugs and Fire Keese spawns a chest containing arrows and unseals a door.

evidence.quote:
Run into the room and start massacring all of the numerous Fire Slugs and Fire
Keese who run around here.  Once all of them are dead, a door will unseal
itself and a chest will appear.  Open the chest to get another bundle of
arrows.

subject: Flaming Enemy Room
text: Smashing the statues with the Megaton Hammer reveals a switch that extinguishes the flame pillar guarding a Small Key chest.

evidence.quote:
Using the Megaton Hammer, smash all of the statues around the perimeter of the
room.  The two statues to the right of the chest of arrows hide a switch and a
golden eye...Step onto the switch, and the pillar of flames guarding the
chest in the center of the room will deactivate.  Open it to get a Small Key.
